title: Never Face The WALL At Grandma's
premise: At Grandma's, nobody sleeps facing the wall or something sits on your bed. After losing my job I face it three nights running and something small sits behind me.
twist: The something is Grandma, who sits with whoever faces the wall because in our family that means they're sad; when her knees can't make the stairs, I sit on Dad's bed for her, then on hers.
world: A small white clapboard house in winter: a lilac spare room with an iron bed against the wall, a sky-blue room across the hall, a butter-yellow kitchen with a mint table, a steep wooden stair.
